newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB cuts Australia credit card rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB cuts Australia credit card rates.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Friday it had reduced interest rates on a range of its credit cards by up to one percentage point effective for new and existing customers from December 2.
NAB said interest rates on its Bankcard, Visa, MasterCard up to 55 interest free period cards, would be cut to 15.85 percent from 16.45 percent.

The bank's Bankcard fee-free no interest free period card would be cut by one percent to 14.95 percent from 15.95 percent. NAB said its Gold MasterCard and National VisaGold would be adjusted to 14.85 percent from 15.45 percent.
The cuts come after the Reserve Bank of Australia reduced official cash rates by 0.5 percent to 6.5 percent on November 6.
